mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_check_in (user_id, check_in_date, study_minutes, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{checkInDate}, #{studyMinutes}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, check_in_date, study_minutes, note, create_time, update_time FROM study_check_in WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_in_date = #{checkInDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, check_in_date, study_minutes, note, create_time, update_time FROM study_check_in WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND check_in_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY check_in_date ASC
SELECT id, user_id, check_in_date, study_minutes, note, create_time, update_time FROM study_check_in WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY check_in_date DESC
